title: Establishment of a Cohort of Patients With Sepsis-associated Encephalopathy (SAE)
brief_summary: In this study, the researcher involved the sepsis patients(defined by sepsis 3.0) in Peking Union Medical College Hospital. The SAE was defined as the Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score of less than 15 and the Non-SAE group GCS = 15. The control group was the non-infectious patients with acute disease strikes and the healthy control. After the sample collection, the RNA-sequence, metabolites and cytokines were under detection.
study_population: Meet the above three categories of patients consistent with inclusion and exclusion criteria
